tickets.title: libworldforge skeleton: pure C++, zero UE dependencies
tickets.description: The move that shapes everything. Compiled twice — CLI for iteration, UE module for shipping. Doc 17.

tickets.title: Immutable phase artifact framework
tickets.description: Every phase writes output and never mutates a previous phase's. Enables re-run-from-phase-N, seed diffing, and image dumps.

tickets.title: Debug PNG dumper
tickets.description: Build this BEFORE phase 1. You cannot debug a world by walking around in it.

tickets.title: Hash-derived subseed utilities (splitmix64)
tickets.description: Never a shared RNG stream. regionSeed, dungeonSeed, lootSeed all derived by hash.

tickets.title: Determinism test in CI
tickets.description: Same seed twice, byte-identical output, on every commit. Determinism regressions are silent and devastating.

tickets.title: Audit for unordered container iteration
tickets.description: The number-one source of 'the same seed made a different world'. Sort keys before looping, everywhere.

tickets.title: Phase 1 — Tectonics
tickets.description: Voronoi plates with type and drift; uplift at convergent boundaries, rifts at divergent. Ranges, not noise blobs.

tickets.title: Phase 2 — Hydraulic and thermal erosion
tickets.description: The highest-value pass in the pipeline. Expensive, which is exactly what forge-once buys. Fixed iteration counts.

tickets.title: Phase 3 — Hydrology
tickets.description: Priority-flood depression filling, D8 or D-infinity flow accumulation, rivers above threshold, channels carved back in.

tickets.title: Phase 4 — Climate with orographic rain shadows
tickets.description: Latitude plus lapse rate for temperature; prevailing wind with orographic lift for moisture. Rain shadows do most for perceived design intent.

tickets.title: Phase 5 — Biomes
tickets.description: Whittaker-style temperature x moisture lookup modulated by slope and elevation, plus axiom injection and suppression.

tickets.title: Phase 6 — Resources
tickets.description: Ore from tectonic data, ley nodes if the Law calls for them, arable score. Where Ore-bound stops being flavour.

tickets.title: Phase 7 — Settlement placement
tickets.description: Suitability scoring plus Poisson-disc spacing, with axiom constraints (Drowning min elevation, traversal-driven density).

tickets.title: Phase 8 — Roads with terrain deformation
tickets.description: A* weighted by slope, water crossings and biome. MST plus ~15% extra edges. Deform terrain to the road, never paint it on.

tickets.title: Phase 9 — Politics
tickets.description: Faction homes, territory flood-fill, relationship matrix, contested cells. See epic 03.

tickets.title: Phase 10 — POI placement with sightline scoring
tickets.description: Raycast from road splines. An entrance nobody can see may as well not exist.

tickets.title: Phase 10 — Landmark visibility coverage validation
tickets.description: Sample the walkable world, require a distinctive silhouette visible or nearby from each point. Gates the no-waypoint navigation design. Doc 11.

tickets.title: Phase 11 — Content binding and manifest
tickets.description: Item distribution, NPC cast, initial quest tensions, dungeon layouts, manifest write.

tickets.title: Phase 12 — UE bake pipeline
tickets.description: Heightmap and weightmaps into Landscape, PCG biome inputs, navmesh, World Partition cells, HLODs. The only phase needing Unreal.

tickets.title: Validation gates and invisible reroll
tickets.description: Arable land, road connectivity, reachability, POI count, contested cell floor, landmark coverage. Reroll with hash(worldSeed, attempt) and log the cause.

tickets.title: Forge progress reporting and loading screen
tickets.description: Worker thread with progress. Put a map drawing itself on screen. Target 30-90s total.

tickets.title: NumPy prototype of phases 1-6
tickets.description: Terrain math is all array operations; iteration speed matters more than runtime. Port phase by phase afterwards, diffing images.

tickets.title: Port phases 1-6 from NumPy to C++
tickets.description: Incremental and verifiable: port a phase, diff its PNG against the reference, move on.

tickets.title: Golden-image tests per phase
tickets.description: Deterministic, pure, image-comparable. The generator is unusually testable.

tickets.title: Erosion performance budget tuning
tickets.description: Erosion dominates at 60-70% of forge time. Fallback: drop to 2048 and upsample before phase 3.
